meta.prepared_by: Senior Product Manager (AI-Generated from Codebase Analysis)

product_overview: Nexus is an AI-powered productivity workspace designed to help teams manage documents, tasks, and workflows more efficiently by leveraging autonomous AI agents and a local-first architecture, ensuring privacy with offline capabilities.
core_goals: Reduce time spent on routine tasks through AI automation to enhance productivity.
Ensure data privacy with a local-first database and optional cloud synchronization.
Enable real-time collaboration with minimal sync latency.
Provide an intuitive and accessible user interface for all skill levels.
key_features: Multi-agent AI system including Supervisor, Researcher, Writer, Coder, and Project Manager agents.
Document management with rich text editor, AI-assisted writing, favorites, archive, and templates.
Kanban-style task management with drag-and-drop, priority levels, AI agent assignment, and due dates.
AI Chat interface supporting multiple agent modes and context-aware responses.
User authentication with email/password and OAuth (GitHub, Google).
Customizable user settings including profile, AI model configuration, API key management, notifications, and appearance.
Advanced animations and smooth scrolling enhancing user experience.
Global command palette for quick navigation and actions.
user_flow_summary: Document Creation: User initiates new document from dashboard, inputs title, uses rich editor with AI assistance, edits, and saves with auto-sync.
Task Management: User views Kanban board, creates and manages tasks with priority, tags, AI or user assignment, and drag-and-drop between columns.
AI Agent Workflow: User selects AI agent workflow type, configures parameters, executes workflow, monitors progress, and saves output.
AI Chat Interaction: User selects AI agent mode, sends messages, receives AI responses with actionable items such as creating documents or tasks.
validation_criteria: Full user authentication including email/password and OAuth with session persistence.
Rich text editor supporting headings, lists, code blocks, inline AI writing commands, and document auto-save.
Kanban task board allowing task creation, prioritization, assignment, due dates, and drag-and-drop functionality.
AI agents executing workflows with real-time progress, history tracking, output viewing, and retry/cancel options.
AI chat interface with selectable modes, message history, copy and retry options, and typing indicators.
Settings supporting profile updates, AI model and API key configuration, notifications, themes, and sync options.
Compliance with performance metrics: page load under 2.5s, real-time sync latency below 200ms, and 60fps animations.
Accessibility adherence to WCAG 2.1 Level AA standards, keyboard navigation, and screen reader compatibility.
Security features including encrypted API keys, HTTPS enforcement, secure cookies, CSRF protection, input sanitization, and rate limiting.
